design.catalog: new instance and fresh Native remote snapshot each round

scope: Same-root cold Graph catalog requests, actual readonly Captain Native remote catalog, warm filesystem. One fresh process per source/consumer count/mode;3 rounds/process. Formal count1/4/32,latency/CPU/separate sampled aggregate RSS, B/A/A/B,n2 processes/source/condition. Actual returned metadata and source index/config/HEAD/full refs exact. No source writes, UI or GitHub timing claim.
limitations: No operation/UI/GitHub latency claim. The32-request stress case is not a frequency measurement of real user traffic.
Four-request latency and single-request CPU increase in this sample. Do not infer universal latency/CPU reduction.

RSS is the median of three observed round maxima per process, then the two-process median. Only2-4samples/round, max actual gap210.929ms and scan171.714ms; short Native peaks can be missed. Not physical memory or whole-Graph retained heap.
